It needs careful implementation of crystal structure sums and numerical root‑finding, but the underlying theory is established and fully laid out in the paper.
rationale.execution: The workflow consists of three sequential steps: compute SMM parameters, solve the EOS for 30 (T,P) points, and produce a CSV. All steps use standard Python libraries, no external tooling or data fetching, and the I/O is simple.
